scope: Publicly documented accelerator software compatibility and integration evidence. Entries are not certification or production-readiness claims.

status_definitions.upstream_supported: The upstream project documentation lists the hardware platform as supported.
status_definitions.vendor_plugin_supported: A vendor or project-maintained out-of-tree plugin documents a released integration and its scope.
status_definitions.vendor_framework: A vendor-maintained framework backend or SDK documents the integration and version matrix.
status_definitions.experimental: A development branch, preview, or upgrade candidate exists, but its own documentation does not yet mark it as a supported release.
status_definitions.in_progress: The upstream project explicitly marks the integration as in progress.
status_definitions.needs_review: Public documentation contains conflicting or incomplete version mapping; do not use as a validated compatibility claim.
status_definitions.vendor_reported: A vendor has publicly reported a model port or validation case; independent reproduction is not established.
